exposure: Fetal central nervous system anomalies diagnosed by ultrasound
cohort: 22,880 pregnant women who underwent ultrasound screening for fetal central nervous system anomalies at 18-20 weeks of gestation
finding: Out of 22,880 pregnant women screened for fetal CNS anomalies, 181 (0.57%) had positive scans, and the majority of these women (56.4%) delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: 102 women (56.4%) delivered vaginally, while 50 (27.6%) delivered by caesarean section.
gest_age: 18-20 weeks at time of screening; 37.5±4.2 weeks at delivery
